description: Procure-to-pay documents: purchase orders and lines, goods receipts and lines, BC purchase invoices and lines, BC purchase credit memos and lines, and document-derived supplier confirmations across the Portal gold tables, FileMaker bronze, the Sage mirror and Business Central. One object per source record; records of one business PO are linked by stored keys (verified) or number text (lead), never merged. Supplier and Product are declared by catalog_parties; bc_finance links its ledger types to these documents.

object_types.description: A Petra purchase order per source record (gold, FM generated PO, Sage PO, BC). Records of one business PO are joined by PurchaseOrder.same_record_as on stored keys; po_number text is unstable (-FM<id> suffix, BC renumbering) and only a lead.

bindings.note: The silver ETL merges its custom_fields into an existing row matched by fmGeneratedPoId, so a Generate-PO row can later carry source 'etl-silver-to-gold'; the UAT- rules run first to catch staging-minted numbers.
Portal Generate PO also inserts FM rows (id = MAX(id)+1, no reserved range); they are recognised through their gold twin's source stamp or a UAT- number.

Open, closed, draft or unknown is decided by the one definition, operating/po_status.py, from this word and the summed line quantities (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-21-po-open-sage-fm.md). Other systems' statuses are separate properties: the vocabularies differ.

properties.name: bc_expected_receipt_date

properties.name: bc_direct_unit_cost
properties.description: BC direct unit cost per the line's unit of measure (unitOfMeasureCode). The Portal means it per the item's base UoM when it writes a line (ERP-M-033); the stored line code is what BC prices it per.

properties.name: bc_amount_excluding_tax
properties.description: BC line amount excluding tax: quantity x direct unit cost after the line discount, before tax, whatever the order's pricesIncludeTax says. The net goods value of the line.

properties.name: bc_line_discount_amount

properties.name: remaining_amount
properties.description: remainingAmount: what is still owed on the posted invoice after payments and applied credit memos, including tax, in the invoice currency. BC API v2.0 documents it on salesInvoice, not on purchaseInvoice; the Portal reads it when BC serves it and takes status Paid as authoritative. A captured invoice without it has no value here (a gap, never zero).
properties.availability_reason: BC does not serve remainingAmount on purchaseInvoices: the live api/v2.0 $metadata (sha256 09a82605, read 2026-10-13, the committed pin) declares no such property, so no captured value is read and the amount still owed is a gap, never zero; the live check schema.bc_metadata_drift reports it now_served if BC starts serving it. status Paid decides the payment stage (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-07-bc-finance-2-payment-ledger.md).

link_types.name: invoices
link_types.description: The BC PO a BC purchase invoice was created from (within one BC company); empty on Portal-created invoices.

link_types.name: names_order
link_types.description: The Portal purchase order a BC purchase invoice names by its order No., the way the Portal itself finds a PO's invoices (TRIM(order_number) equal to the PO number): it reaches a Portal PO's invoices also when BC has deleted the posted BC PO, so no PurchaseInvoice.invoices link and no same_record_as twin is left. BC numbers are unique only within one company and the Portal row does not serve its book, so the projector caps each link at lead (bc_company_not_known); company_by_reader lets plx.process count it only for a reader who reads every company and sees the PO's number named in one company alone. Invoices of several companies, or an invoice naming several Portal POs, name several orders: an ambiguous_target gap, never a pick.

portal.align_po_number_to_bc.note: After drain, po_number is rewritten to the BC No.; custom_fields gets fmPoNumber, renumberedTo = BC No., renumberSource 'bc-drain-align'.

portal.bc_company_pins.note: BC books: BcBookKey manufacturing | distribution | consol, matched by company GUID / expectedNames (My Company / PLX Manufacturing, PLX Distribution, PLX Consol). Lineage bc_<book>; the consol book holds consolidation copies and is never authority.

portal.bc_po_finance_invoice_match.note: A PO's BC purchase invoices are those whose TRIM(order_number) equals the trimmed Portal PO number (or its BC PO number), or whose vendor_invoice_number is one recorded on the PO's receipts; the snapshot query has no company filter. Unchanged at c3ffda3 (line 326, as the lane cites it at the repo pin 549f6f0e).

portal.bc_drain_purchase_invoice.note: Portal creates BC purchaseInvoices with vendorInvoiceNumber; orderId/orderNumber are read-only and omitted, so AP joins Portal by vendorInvoiceNumber <-> app_receipt.

portal.bc_drain_purchase_receipts.note: Portal reads BC posted purchaseReceipts back by $filter orderNumber eq '<BC PO No.>'.

portal.bc_serialize_purchase_order.note: BC purchase order payload: orderDate = order_date, poNumber = po_number, line quantity, directUnitCost.

portal.bc_transaction_currency.note: bcTransactionCurrency: CAD (and empty) is sent as no currencyCode, i.e. BC local currency; other codes are sent upper-case.

portal.catalog_facts.sage_keys.note: Catalog facts: Sage header primary keys orduniq/shiuniq/invuniq/porhseq/rcphseq; detail rows unique on _sage_pk.

portal.etl_silver_po_lines.note: FM generated_purchase_order_item -> app_purchase_order_line, grouped by gold PO resolved via fmGeneratedPoId then po_number.

portal.qa_po_receive_smoke.note: The QA PO receive smoke inserts a gold app_purchase_order with customFields {qaSmoke: true, qaTag, source 'qa-po-receive-smoke', fmGeneratedPoId, fmPoNumber} (lines 111-116); createFmPo inserts its FM generated_purchase_order twin (lines 147-156): a test row, never a business PO. Unchanged at 6e76a5b.

portal.etl_silver_po_custom_fields_merge.note: The silver ETL finds an existing gold PO by customFields.fmGeneratedPoId/fmPoNumber and merges custom_fields || {fmGeneratedPoId, fmPoNumber, source 'etl-silver-to-gold'}: source is overwritten, qaSmoke survives, so qaSmoke decides the lineage before source. Unchanged at 6e76a5b.

portal.etl_silver_purchase_orders.note: silver.purchase_orders -> app_purchase_order stamps customFields {fmGeneratedPoId, fmPoNumber, source 'etl-silver-to-gold'}; matches existing gold by fmGeneratedPoId first and never rolls a LINKED/canonical No. back.

portal.etl_silver_receipts.note: silver.receipts -> app_receipt copies po_item_id, po_reference, supplier_name; it sets no purchase_order_id.

portal.generate_po_fm_ids.note: Generate PO inserts FM generated_purchase_order rows with id = MAX(id)+1, so Portal-minted FM POs have no id range of their own.

portal.generate_po_gold.note: Generate PO writes FM generated_purchase_order first, then a gold PO with customFields {fmGeneratedPoId, fmPoNumber, source 'portal-generate-po'} (status SUBMITTED, currency CAD).

portal.mirror_fm_pos_to_gold.note: FM PO -> gold mirror stamps customFields {fmGeneratedPoId, fmPoNumber, source 'mirror-fm-pos-to-gold'}.

portal.po_fulfillment_status.note: derivePoFulfillmentCode derives DRAFT, SUBMITTED, PARTIAL, RECEIVED or CANCELLED from the header word and SUM(quantity) vs SUM(quantity_received) of the lines; the header column itself holds the FileMaker words (operating/po_status.py mirrors it).

portal.po_number_series.note: Legacy FM/portal PO numbers (PO#5280, UAT-PO#5283) are kept in custom_fields.fmPoNumber; the UAT- prefix marks staging-minted numbers.

portal.receipt_lab_id.note: Lab ids: raw YYDDD-N, packaging RP+7 digits, both via prefixRef ('UAT-YYDDD-N' on staging).

portal.receive_qty_to_purchase_uom.note: Received kg converted to the PO line purchase UoM via FM kgperuofm_c before updating quantity_received.

portal.uat_prefix.note: prefixRef() prepends NEXT_PUBLIC_UAT_REF_PREFIX to Portal-minted reference numbers on the staging/UAT database so they are distinguishable from FM-generated ones.

portal.upsert_gold_receipt.note: Go-forward gold receipt: one header + one line per lab id (receipt_number = lab id); purchase_order_id resolved by TRIM(po_number) = TRIM(poNumber) text (resolvePurchaseOrderId); freight/duties kept only on the first receipt of a PO.

portal.upsert_gold_receipt_line.note: Gold receipt line insert carries lab_id, quantity and uom; quantity is in the gold PO line's purchase UoM.

prisma.purchase_order.note: model PurchaseOrder @@map("app_purchase_order"): poNumber unique, supplierId FK, status String, orderDate = column date_generated, expectedDate, shippingCost/dutiesCost are estimates (ERP-D-015), currency default CAD, incoterms, shippedAt, customFields Json.

prisma.purchase_order_line.note: model PurchaseOrderLine @@map("app_purchase_order_line"): purchaseOrderId FK, productId FK, quantity, unitPrice, uom (purchase UoM), quantityReceived.

prisma.receipt.note: model Receipt @@map("app_receipt"): receiptNumber unique, purchaseOrderId optional, supplierId, receivedDate default now(), status String, vendorInvoiceNumber (-> BC purchaseInvoices.vendorInvoiceNumber, ERP-M-026), freightCost/dutiesCost actuals (ERP-D-015), poReference, poItemId.

prisma.receipt_line.note: model ReceiptLine @@map("app_receipt_line"): receiptId FK, productId FK, labId, quantity, uom, supplierLotNumber, expiryDate, status.

workbench.bc_purchase_quantities.note: QUANTITY_FIELDS: purchaseOrderLines quantity=ordered, receivedQuantity=received, invoicedQuantity is not a quantity_types role; receipts found by orderNumber, invoices by orderNumber/vendorInvoiceNumber (number equality = reference, not identity).

workbench.bc_query_specs.note: BC_QUERY_SPECS: selectable fields per BC entity set (salesOrders, salesInvoices, purchaseOrders, purchaseReceipts, purchaseInvoices and their lines); BC_DOCUMENT_LINES reads lines only by nested navigation from the header id.

workbench.mail_mentions.note: PO-to-mail links come from identifier mentions in subject/body plus sender domain; leads until corroborated.

workbench.bc_same_company_scope.note: Both ends are BC captures: compare only within one BC company (bc_<book> equal on both ends). BC numbers are unique per company only; masters synced to several books and consolidation copies reuse them (SO vs DSO series: outbox-drain.ts:880-890 @b46934a). Machine-readable today as ontology.schema.link_company_scope / CompiledSchema.company_scope; a C0 field is asked in devloop/OPEN-DECISIONS.md bc-link-company-scope.

allowlist.sage.po_receipt_header.multipo.note: Sage receipt headers serve multipor/pors: one receipt can cover several POs, while the header porhseq/ponumber name only one of them, and the served receipt detail carries no PO key (rcphseq/rcplseq only). The header pair is therefore capped at corroborated: never a fact that this is the receipt's only PO, and a multi-PO receipt's totals must not be attributed to it. C0 cannot condition a link tier on multipor (devloop/OPEN-DECISIONS.md sage-multi-po-receipts).

workbench.bc_line_price_uom.note: BC_QUERY_SPECS serves unitOfMeasureCode on every BC document line next to its quantity and its unitPrice/directUnitCost/unitCost. Business Central prices a document line per the line's Unit of Measure Code (the line's quantity is counted in the same code), so the line's code is the price's denominator. The Portal never folds its BC codes back, so the unit fold (ontology/units.py) folds one only where the Portal's own table spells it: PCS is the Portal alias pcs (ea) and CSE the option cse, so a BC PCS price and a Portal ea price share a denominator, while GR stays gr, never g.

portal.purchase_order_line_price_per_uom.note: Portal-native PO lines: totalPrice = quantity x unitPrice with the line's uom (required on every line).

portal.distribution_po_line_price_per_uo.note: Distribution PO lines: totalPrice = unitPrice x quantity with the line's uom.

portal.generate_po_line_price_per_uom.note: Generate PO gold lines: unitPrice is the reorder item's per-UoM cost, written with that item's uom.

portal.fm_po_lines_uom_literal_ea.note: FM PO lines -> gold: unit_price = COALESCE(costentry_c, itemcost) (the FM item cost) and uom is the literal 'ea', whatever unit the FM cost is per.

portal.mirror_fm_po_lines_uom_literal_ea.note: FM PO mirror -> gold lines: unitPrice = costentry_c ?? itemcost and uom: 'ea' as a literal.

workbench.bc_purchase_credit_memos.note: BC_QUERY_SPECS purchaseCreditMemos / purchaseCreditMemoLines: field names from the BC API v2.0 purchaseCreditMemo and purchaseCreditMemoLine resources (MicrosoftDocs dynamics365smb-devitpro-pb api-reference/v2.0); invoiceId / invoiceNumber name the invoice the memo is applied to. Captured by integrations.bc_read.BcCapture (lines by nested navigation); unverified live until devloop/live-checks/bc.capture_full.json records the units complete.

workbench.bc_payment_state_decision.note: Cites plx-customer-portal@790256c portal/src/lib/business-central/inbound.ts (projectPurchaseInvoice, read at that commit, not at this domain's b46934a pin): the Portal's BC inbound snapshot reads remainingAmount on purchase invoices when BC serves it ('purchaseInvoices may omit remainingAmount; status=Paid is authoritative'); customer/vendor ledger entries are optional collections it skips on 404 (shouldSkipMissingPostedCollection).

workbench.bc_company_local_currency.note: BC API v2.0 companyInformation.currencyCode (pinned $metadata; the generated type RelBcCompanyInformation, captured once per company): the company's local currency (LCY) code. A BC document whose currencyCode is blank is in that local currency: the Portal sends CAD and an empty currency as no currencyCode (bcTransactionCurrency, portal.bc_transaction_currency). The projector reads it on the one companyInformation record of the document's company (lineage bc_<book>); without that capture the currency stays unresolved (currency_unknown). Live-unverified until a live read shows a blank-currency document beside its company's companyInformation.

workbench.bc_prices_include_tax.note: BC API v2.0 purchaseOrder / purchaseInvoice pricesIncludeTax (Edm.Boolean, nullable; pinned $metadata ontology/schema/generated/meta/bc_metadata.json) states whether the document's line prices include tax; the capture reads it on the header (integrations/bc_read.py reads every field; integrations/bc_purchase.py selects it). A line price reads it through its header: true is incl_tax, false excl_tax, null unknown. Caveat: the PO line compares directUnitCost and the invoice line unitCost, which may include indirect cost. Live-unverified.

context.portal.3.11.note: BC tables are outside the pinned reporting-API manifest; the live catalog (GET /v1/relations, 2026-10-26) lists public.bc_purchase_invoice_snapshot, so its rows are Portal copies of BC invoices with no company column.
